stories.title: US bombers moved from UK airbase due to Iran-linked threats, Trump says

en.title: US bombers moved from UK airbase due to Iran-linked threats, Trump says
en.summary: US President Trump announced that American B-1 bombers were removed from RAF Fairford in Britain following a threat linked to Iran. The move came after five British men were arrested near the base on suspicion of preparing terrorist acts.

stories.title: Hong Kong must scrap housing plan and preserve golf course

en.title: Hong Kong must scrap housing plan and preserve golf course
en.summary: Hong Kong's government will not appeal a court ruling that found its approval of an environmental impact assessment for a housing development on the city's oldest golf course to be unlawful. The decision allows for a broader review of the disputed project.

stories.title: Mainland Chinese favour diplomacy to achieve Taiwan reunification with caveats: survey

en.title: Mainland Chinese favour diplomacy to achieve Taiwan reunification with caveats: survey
en.summary: A survey of mainland Chinese citizens shows preference for diplomatic and coercive measures over military force regarding Taiwan reunification, while American approval remains low despite openness to US engagement on trade and security matters.

stories.title: Jeffrey Archer, former British politician and novelist, dies aged 86

en.title: Jeffrey Archer, former British politician and novelist, dies aged 86
en.summary: Jeffrey Archer, a former Conservative MP and bestselling novelist who sold over 300 million copies worldwide, has died at age 86 at his home in Britain.

stories.title: Beijing wanted more from Xi’s Washington state visit

en.title: Beijing wanted more from Xi's Washington state visit
en.summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping's September state visit to Washington included ceremonial events and meetings with US President Donald Trump. Beijing reportedly expected greater outcomes from the diplomatic engagement.

stories.title: Former American Idol singer Caleb Flynn sentenced to life in prison for wife’s murder

en.title: Former American Idol singer Caleb Flynn sentenced to life in prison for wife's murder
en.summary: A former music pastor and American Idol contestant was sentenced to life without parole after being convicted of murdering his wife in Ohio. Prosecutors alleged he staged a home invasion to conceal the crime.

stories.title: Bogota mayor presses Chinese-led consortium for more metro workers as auditors flag delays

en.title: Bogota mayor presses Chinese-led consortium for more metro workers as auditors flag delays
en.summary: Bogota's mayor requested the Chinese-led metro line consortium increase staffing levels due to construction delays. National auditors warned that project setbacks could postpone the March 2028 opening.

stories.title: ICC unseals arrest warrants for 4 Taliban leaders wanted on gender persecution charges

en.title: ICC unseals arrest warrants for 4 Taliban leaders wanted on gender persecution charges
en.summary: The International Criminal Court issued arrest warrants for four senior Taliban leaders accused of crimes against humanity involving gender-based persecution since 2021. The charges include persecution of women, girls, and LGBTQ individuals.

stories.title: Quebec votes in provincial election as separatist surge poses test for Canada’s PM Carney

en.title: Quebec votes in provincial election as separatist surge poses test for Canada's PM Carney
en.summary: Quebec held a provincial election where separatist parties showed signs of returning to power. Prime Minister Mark Carney remains popular in the province, and the separatists' potential success is not viewed as rejection of his approach to US relations.

stories.title: After plague death reports at Siberia lab, Russia says situation under control

en.title: After plague death reports at Siberia lab, Russia says situation under control
en.summary: Russia downplayed reports that a 28-year-old technician at a Siberian anti-plague institute died of plague, stating postmortem tests did not confirm the disease. The US said it was monitoring the situation closely.

stories.title: US to announce US$150 million for Alaska power lines as Vance visits battleground state

en.title: US to announce US$150 million for Alaska power lines as Vance visits battleground state
en.summary: The US Energy Department announced $150 million in funding for Alaska power lines during Vice-President J.D. Vance's visit to the state. Vance campaigned for Republican Senator Dan Sullivan in a competitive re-election race.

stories.title: 迪拜航空客机上到底发生了什么 遭袭机长等人“还原”惊魂时刻

en.title: What exactly happened on the Dubai Airlines aircraft – crew members 'recreate' the terrifying moment
en.summary: On September 30, a Dubai Airlines flight experienced a severe emergency when the aircraft dropped nearly 4,300 meters in 30 seconds. Passengers and crew members subdued the co-pilot who had stabbed the captain, regained control of the aircraft, and made an emergency landing in Saudi Arabia.

stories.title: ​​​​​​​Planning a Legacy for Lives that Keep Moving

en.title: Planning a Legacy for Lives that Keep Moving
en.summary: Chubb offers a multi-currency insurance plan designed to help families pass wealth to the next generation with flexibility in timing, methods, and currency options to accommodate changing family circumstances.

stories.title: Adrian Cheng, former scion of Hong Kong’s NWD, expands K11 brand in Xiamen

en.title: Adrian Cheng, former scion of Hong Kong's NWD, expands K11 brand in Xiamen
en.summary: Adrian Cheng is expanding his K11 cultural retail business in mainland China with a new venture in Xiamen, which has attracted over 2 million visits since opening in September with sales rising 32 percent.

stories.title: HKMA licenses Bakai Bank, city’s first from Central Asia

en.title: HKMA licenses Bakai Bank, city's first from Central Asia
en.summary: Hong Kong's monetary authority has granted a banking license to Bakai Bank, a major Kyrgyzstani lender, making it the first Central Asian bank to operate in Hong Kong as a restricted license bank.

stories.title: Hong Kong lawmakers say 5-year tax incentive too short to entice major innovative firms

en.title: Hong Kong lawmakers say 5-year tax incentive too short to entice major innovative firms
en.summary: Hong Kong lawmakers support the government's proposed tax incentives for innovative companies but argue that the planned five-year period is insufficient to attract major firms to establish headquarters or expand in the city.

stories.title: HKTDC’s Belt and Road Summit drives momentum

en.title: HKTDC's Belt and Road Summit drives momentum
en.summary: The 11th Belt and Road Summit held in Hong Kong in September brought together over 6,200 officials and business leaders from more than 70 countries to explore cooperation opportunities.
